name: Mailbox role name
description: A stable session address (<owner>/s/<name>) a session claims with mailbox.sh claim, stored as alias:<owner>:<name> with the holder's session id and last_seen. Mail to it waits in its inbox across holder restarts. A claimed name wins over the status-bar name and the project-id default but not over a MAILBOX_SESSION that no other live pane holds.

meanings.free: No alias key (never claimed, released, or aged out after 30 days).
meanings.held: Alias key names a holder seen within the last 10 minutes.
meanings.stale: Alias key names a holder not seen for 10 minutes or more.

transitions.guard: SET NX succeeds and the read-back shows this session id

transitions.trigger: Hook heartbeat or a re-claim by the holder
transitions.guard: Stored session id is this session's; last_seen refreshed
No heartbeat (session ended or idle without hook events)
lock:<owner>:alias-<name> taken with SET NX; read-back shows the new holder
